gbm_population_evidence.quote: Confirmation of anaplastic glioma (i.e., oligodendroglioma, astrocytoma, oligoastrocytoma) or GBM histology if there is less than 50% involvement of the pons.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Target population is diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma; GBM is named only as one acceptable histology in an inclusion criterion, so could be not_glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Antineoplaston therapy (Atengenal + Astugenal) by IV infusion every four hours for 104 weeks.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly Diagnosed Diffuse, Intrinsic, Brainstem Glioma

role_evidence.quote: Subjects ≥ 3 years of age with a diffuse, intrinsic brain stem glioma will receive Atengenal in combination with Astugenal (Antineoplaston therapy) and radiation
Subjects ≥ 3 years of age with a diffuse, intrinsic brain stem glioma will receive Astugenal in combination with Atengenal (Antineoplaston therapy) and radiation

coder_notes: Primarily a diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma trial (ages from 3 years; mixed age). Adults and GBM histology are allowed, hence mixed_glioma_gbm_named with uncertain flag. The radiation-only arm is registered as EXPERIMENTAL but works as the control arm. Atengenal and Astugenal have no INN in the record; names as registered.
